reviewed_exclusions.reason: Northern News Now article published Nov 9, 2026 reports a newly opened Lincoln Park grocery store in Duluth, Minnesota, not a closure; is outside requested loss class.
Oregon SNAP documentation change begins November 21, 2026 for new applications/renewals; no evidenced immediate interruption in this 22:52–23:48 PST window.
Hawaiʻi SNAP applications/renewals page acknowledges ongoing long call center waits but gives no evidence of a new interruption during the hourly window.
California WIC notice dated Sep 2, 2026 says offices/enrollment continue; no interruption.
Provo, Utah food bank shutdown effective Nov 1 reported Oct 31; previously known, out of window.
Eau Claire distribution cancellation published Nov 3 and updated Nov 6; already observed and no new announcement.
Kauaʻi hurricane recovery update Nov 6 lists distribution proceeding, no new cancellation.
El Paso storm-damaged food bank closure published Sep 25; older resolved event.

coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Excluded historical and duplicate closures, older storm cancellations, 2025 SNAP shutdown articles recirculated in 2026 search, food-access openings, donation appeals, generic aid guides, routine program promotion, and policy changes without immediate benefit interruption.
coverage_notes.assessment: No new qualifying immediate U.S. food-access disruption identified by 12 targeted searches plus nine direct checks since 2026-11-09 22:52:17 PST. Bounded supplementary recall, not comprehensive nationwide clearance.
